Cash register exercise 

Cash register exercise from freeCodeCamp JavaScript Certification course. This exercise was really a challenge it took a long time ti figure out my solution. At first I couldn't figure out how to dynamically compa.re change wich is a number to the type of coin which was a string, the solution being a simple object that has the coin types as keys and their values as values. Another thing that caught me off guard until I figured out what was happening, numbers getting microscopically smaller e.g. 96.74 - 60 = 36.7399999999994. However a simple rounding helped a lot. I believe this challenge, at least for me, was the most rewarding out of all of them
